resolutions.researcher_notes: [Phase II, Ganzhou South Branch (Dayu-Xinfeng Segment)] CROSS-SHARD OPERATOR TENSION (filed by the coordinator, not by a research shard -- this row's own shard never saw the evidence). Batch_03 established from TWO independent documents -- the CCXI 2022 credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 and the quannan.gov.cn wrfz2.pdf emergency-response plan, whose own 运行单位 field names the parent Group directly -- that the 54%/46% JV (江西省天然气管道有限公司 + 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司) operates PHASE I only (川气东送-sourced), while PHASE II (西气东输-sourced) runs under the Group's own 管道分公司 internal division with no JV/PipeChina involvement. THIS ROW IS EXPLICITLY PHASE II per its SegmentName, and its shard staged the 54/46 JV against Operator [ref]. Nine Phase II rows are in scope (P4785/P4786/P4787/P4788/P4789/P4790/P4791/P5860/P5863); batch_03's own sentinel covers P4786-P4788, so this record widens the same finding to the rows its author could not see. TWO CAVEATS, both against overreading this: (1) the staged value sits in the QCCOwner(业主单位) column -- an OWNER/proprietor-unit fact from the QCC business registry -- whereas batch_03's evidence concerns the 运行单位 (OPERATING unit). Those are different facts and the JV may well be a correct Phase II owner even if it is the wrong operator, so this is a question to adjudicate, NOT an established contradiction. (2) All nine rows are currently BLANK for Operator and Owner on the operators/owners tab (GID 1489950650, verified against the 20260902 snapshot), so nothing is at risk of being overwritten -- the only decision is which proposal, if any, gets pasted. NO value, ref, class or tier has been changed on any shard record. Recommend adjudicating the Phase I/Phase II operator split ONCE for the whole cohort rather than row by row.

verifications.note: 经济参考报 via 中新网, 2012-10-22: '西三线包括1条干线8条支线3座储气库和1座液化天然气应急调峰站，总投资1250亿元' -- the 125bn total explicitly covers 3 gas storage facilities and 1 LNG emergency peaking station alongside the trunk and 8 branches.

resolutions.researcher_notes: SCOPE MISMATCH on SegmentCost, flagged not changed. GEM's P4934 SegmentCost is 125,000,000,000 RMB and the sourcing found this pass matches it exactly -- so the ref is correct about where the number comes from. But the source defines that 1250亿元 as the total for 1 trunk + 8 branches + 3 GAS STORAGE FACILITIES + 1 LNG PEAKING STATION. Storage and an LNG station are not pipeline and are not what a GGIT pipeline row costs, so GEM's figure plausibly OVERSTATES the pipeline's capital cost by the non-pipe components. This is the batch's standing aggregate-vs-segment hazard in a shape the guardrail does not catch: the row IS the whole system (SegmentName blank), so the system-vs-segment test passes, but the SOURCE's system is broader than GEM's. Recommend no value change without a pipe-only figure; the disaggregation available (registered capital 625亿元, PetroChina 52%/325亿元) does not separate pipe from storage either. Related: SegmentCostYear is blank on the sheet and both sources date the figure to the 2012-10-16 groundbreaking, so 2012 is the defensible denomination year -- not staged here, noted for the researcher. SegmentCostUnits 'RMB' is correct and is the tab's own convention (601 rows), not a controlled-vocab violation.

[Phase I Fengxin Branch (Chigang-Fengxin)] CROSS-SHARD FUELSOURCE / PHASE MISMATCH (filed by the coordinator; batch_17 found this on ONE row, inside a FuelSource [ref] record's notes, where it would have reached Baird only as an aside on an UNRESOLVED unit -- the same burial that hid Egypt's P5121 StartYear finding inside another row's record). THE SAME 2022 CCXI credit-rating report for the parent Group (http://qxb-pdf-osscache.qixin.com/AnBaseinfo/85599868a5a6e3c2fc8db704da8180b8.pdf) that splits the OPERATOR by phase (see the P4785/P4790/P5860 sentinels in this file and batch_03's) splits the GAS SOURCE the same way, and it is one fact, not two: PHASE I ('一期管网', the ~870 km Poyang-Lake network built to 2012) is fed from 川气东送 Sichuan-East Gas Transmission; PHASE II ('二期管网工程', from 2016) is fed from 西气东输二线 West-East Gas Pipeline 2. Every in-scope row's own SegmentName states its phase, so the column is checkable against the row's own label. Cross-tab of the 44 in-scope rows (GGIT_gas_snapshot_20260902.csv): 23 carry a phase label -- 15 Phase I, 8 Phase II -- and of those 23, TWELVE have FuelSource blank and FIVE are filled. Of the five, THREE are in tension with their own phase label: P5862 (this row, r3326) reads 'West-East Gas Pipeline' on a Phase I branch; P5866 (r3330) reads 'West-East Gas Pipeline Line 2 and Sichuan-to-East Gas Transmission' on a Phase I branch, i.e. half of it is the Phase II source; and in the OPPOSITE direction P4787/P4788 (r2676/r2677) read 'Sichuan-Shanghai gas pipeline/West-East gas pipeline II' on PHASE II branches, naming the Phase I source first -- note 川气东送 is rendered in this tab BOTH as 'Sichuan-to-East Gas Transmission' and as 'Sichuan-Shanghai Gas Pipeline', so those are the same source under two English names. Only P4777 (r2666, Phase I, 'receives natural gas from the Jiujiang terminal of the Sichuan-to-East gas transmission Huangmei branch') is consistent with its label. P4789 (r2678, Phase II) names three sources incl. WEP3 and is the separate open question already flagged on P4788 in the v1 batch. NOT AUTO-CORRECTED, and deliberately so: the report's statement is NETWORK-level, it records 81 km of new pipe added network-wide in 2021 that could include cross-network interconnection, and a branch physically fed from a Phase I trunk can still carry gas that entered the system from WEP2 upstream -- FuelSource may be answering a different question than the phase label does. It also has no [ref] on ANY of the five filled rows, so there is nothing to check the values against. FOR BAIRD: this is one convention question to settle once for the whole Jiangxi provincial network -- does FuelSource name the trunk the branch physically taps, or the field/import the molecules originate from? -- and the answer then fills 12 blanks and regrades 3-5 filled cells. It travels with the operator/phase thread; adjudicate them together.
